subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: What media-store and sandbox-staging size-limit contract should OpenClaw support, including default, hard maximum, and precedence with existing mediaMaxMb settings?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but choosing the permanent cap contract changes configuration semantics and sandbox resource boundaries, which requires maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Define a bounded shared limit
options.body: Add a documented and validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire all affected media paths to the same resolved value.

options.title: Land only the Telegram slice
options.body: Review the focused Telegram PR for immediate outbound document relief while keeping this issue open for the broader store and sandbox-staging contract.

options.title: Keep the fixed cap
options.body: Retain the fixed 5 MiB core cap and accept continued failures for larger sandboxed media unless per-path exceptions are explicitly added.

recommendation.title: Define a bounded shared limit
recommendation.body: Add a documented and validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire all affected media paths to the same resolved value.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses sandbox/media security boundaries where this history shows the clearest owner signal.
